column2: Events for one case are processed in the order they were written, by a sequence per case in the outbox
At least once; consumers are idempotent
Each event carries an event ID and an idempotency key; a repeat is ignored and counted (R-UNI-40)
The event is written in the same transaction as the change; no event without the change and no change without the event
References and codes; no personal data
An event carries its schema version; consumers accept the current and previous version
A consumer failure retries; after the limit the event goes to the exception queue with its owner
